notes.note: Reviewed all four invitation capture records against the changed fixture file. The delta only adds notification query/mutation exports to the ProjectSettingsView data plugin; the separate invitationFixture, authorityFixture, invitation controls, routes and screenshot loop are unchanged. All three browser tests passed. Inspected generated invitation-journey-audit/390-light.png and 1440-dark.png for layout and reachable controls. Existing capture bytes and their fixture-only/API-persistence limits remain unchanged; no live invitation or hosted qualification claim.
